faqs.q: How can I check if I can drive a specific vehicle?
faqs.a: You can check online using any combination of vehicle details by visiting the Centre for Road Safety's P1/P2 high performance vehicle restrictions search.

faqs.q: What are the restrictions for P1 and P2 provisional licence holders?
faqs.a: P1 and P2 provisional licence holders are banned from driving high performance vehicles that have certain characteristics.

faqs.q: What if I need an exemption from these restrictions?
faqs.a: You can apply for an exemption from prohibited vehicle or passenger conditions.
